refundPolicy.checkoutLine: Full refund within 14 days of your first payment (once per person) or of an annual renewal. Monthly renewals aren't refundable.
refundPolicy.termsParagraph: You can ask for a full refund within 14 days of your first subscription payment; this is available once per person (per email address). Annual renewal charges can also be refunded in full within 14 days of the renewal. Monthly renewal charges are not refundable. A refund ends your subscription immediately and your account returns to the Free plan. Otherwise we do not provide refunds or credits for partial billing periods, except where the law requires it.
refundPolicy.managePlanLine: Within 14 days of your first payment, or of an annual renewal, you can get a full refund. Your plan ends right away.
